name: @dsh-one/dsh-llm-provider
description: A dsh plugin that replaces the built-in llm-pi-ai and llm-deepseek adapters, the model selector and the Models settings page with self-maintained versions, tracks upstream @earendil-works/pi-ai, adds OAuth/device-code sign-in for subscription providers (Copilot, Codex, Claude…), and adds quota/balance lookups plus a provider management UI

scripts.test: npm run build && node test/routes.mjs && node test/credential-check.mjs && node test/cordis-patch.mjs && node test/pi-ai-probe.mjs && node test/link-removal.mjs && node test/prune-plan.mjs && node test/model-details.mjs && node test/provider-config.mjs && node test/model-discovery.mjs && node test/provider-presets.mjs && node test/vendor-status.mjs && node test/oauth.mjs && node test/github-copilot-usage.mjs && node test/official-rows.mjs && node test/client-smoke.mjs
